name: Starter
about: The starter project: one short reel, about Repo2Reels itself. Start your own from it with: python3 make.py new yourproduct

lines.text: Your repo can make its own reels.
Just write five lines about your product.
Repo to Reels speaks them, scores the music, and cuts each scene on the beat.
No API keys. No GPU. It runs on your own computer.
Repo to Reels. Free and open source, on GitHub.
